title: His Church or His Child? A Sixth-Generation Member of a Faith-Healing Sect Had to Choose.
author: Samantha Swindler
content:
What if you had to pick between your deeply held faith and the life of your
child? That’s the gutting choice that faced Marshall Phillips, an Oregon dad
who was born into the Followers of Christ, a sect whose creed bars medical
treatment. When his 11-year-old son was stricken with a dire health crisis,
Phillips became caught between his faith, his family and the state of Oregon,
which had begun cracking down on faith-healing parents who don’t seek medical
help for their minor children. A decade later, Phillips was pulled into
another one of his church’s life-or-death dramas when he was asked to care for
a newborn whose twin had died because her parents had refused to seek medical
attention.

### Read More

[ ![](https://www.propublica.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Followers-of-
Christ3061-SG-edit-
featured_maxHeight_3000_maxWidth_3000.jpg?w=459&h=306&crop=1) **Prophecy,
Scorn and a Rejection of This World: The Forbidding Vision of a Faith-Healing
Preacher** ](https://www.propublica.org/article/walter-white-faith-healing-
oregon)

To examine the power of faith-healing churches and the toll of their
teachings, The Oregonian investigative reporter Noelle Crombie, senior staff
photojournalist Beth Nakamura and videographer Samantha Swindler spent months
with Phillips and his family, piecing together rare accounts from inside the
deeply shuttered world of the Followers of Christ and of the state officials
who fought to protect children who need medical treatment. The documentary,
produced by The Oregonian’s managing producer of video, Teresa Mahoney, not
only lays out in visceral detail the agonizing choices that families like the
Phillips have to make, it also chronicles how they overcame the clash with
their religious beliefs.

Go inside the secretive Followers of Christ sect and [watch the extraordinary
journey](http://youtube.com/watch?v=kM6Ewe9rkGc).  
  
Read more in this [riveting print
narrative](https://www.propublica.org/article/followers-of-christ-oregon-city-
evelyn-marshall-phillips), and meet [the man who dominated and shaped the
sect](https://www.propublica.org/article/walter-white-faith-healing-oregon).
